name: PlayInfo
description: Admin playback session monitor displaying active streams, play state, and real-time transcode telemetry.
overview: Admin playback session monitor displaying active streams, play state, and real-time transcode telemetry.

versions.changelog: Release v0.2.7.6 - Discord/Telegram notifications now attach the item's poster image directly, uploaded as part of the same request rather than a link back to the server, so it works even on servers that aren't internet-reachable; falls back to text-only when no image is cached (on by default, can be turned off). The summary strip gains a live bandwidth gauge showing total outbound bitrate, split by Local Network vs. Remote when that badge is enabled, plus an optional percentage against an admin-configured upload limit. Sessions paused a while now show a warning pill (escalating from amber to red past an hour) so a forgotten paused stream holding server resources doesn't go unnoticed, and a badge appears when one account has more than one stream running. The Send Message admin action now offers quick-fill presets, and the Info panel gets a Copy Report button producing a sanitized per-session technical summary (no username, device, or IP) for sharing in a forum post or issue. Added a Recent Sessions shelf -- a short in-memory history of finished playback, cleared on restart, no database. Also fixes two Telegram bugs: saving a bot token no longer requires a Chat ID to already be set, and notification duration text no longer wraps past 24 hours.

Release v0.2.7.5 - Added a second Info view: click Info while 'Right' is selected (next to the existing 'Down' toggle) to open a centered dialog with the poster on the left and the full Tautulli-style Product/Player/Quality/Stream/Container/Video/Audio/Subtitle/Location/Bandwidth field list on the right, instead of expanding the card in place. The original Down behavior is unchanged. Transcode reasons are now itemized with red/amber severity, shown both as a details-panel banner and as warning rings on the affected pills, so it is clear at a glance why a stream is transcoding and how serious it is. Compact/Extended switches and opening Info now animate instead of snapping open. Also adds a strictly opt-in (off by default) Local Network/Remote badge, with an optional city/country lookup for remote sessions via a third-party geolocation service -- the raw IP address is never exposed or logged.

Release v0.2.7.4 - Added detection for stale, superseded plugin version folders left behind after an update. Jellyfin's own plugin loader can, in rare cases, silently keep running an old build instead of a newer one already installed (a real bug in Jellyfin itself, tracked upstream as jellyfin/jellyfin#17699) -- when that happens, fixes from later releases never take effect, with no error shown anywhere. The plugin now checks for this at every startup and logs a warning if found, and the System Diagnostics section shows a banner naming the older folder(s) with an explicit 'Remove' button per folder. Removal is always an admin-confirmed, one-click action -- never automatic -- and it refuses to remove anything unless it can positively confirm the folder belongs to this plugin and is strictly older than the version currently running.

Release v0.2.7.3 - Replaced hand-drawn approximate client icons with verified real logos: Apple, Apple TV, Linux, Firefox, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Windows, Xbox, PlayStation, Chromecast, Kodi, Google TV, and Chrome (the real current multi-color logo). Official Jellyfin apps (Web/Mobile/Android TV/Desktop) now show Jellyfin's actual mascot mark instead of a generic device outline. Moonfin, Finamp, and Streamyfin icons now match their real app logos instead of approximate shapes. Fixed the original bug properly: the Apple TV and Linux icons weren't just small, they were using a near-black fill against a near-black card background and were rendering as almost invisible. Added a small PlayInfo watermark badge to the corner of every card so the data source is identifiable at a glance.

Release v0.2.7.2 - Fixed the real cause of notification toggles (Master Switch, Discord, Telegram) always showing as off/disabled even when they were saved correctly: the settings API's JSON response used PascalCase field names while the page's JavaScript read camelCase, so every reload silently read undefined instead of the real value. Also fixed the same issue for the Test Discord/Test Telegram buttons and the System Diagnostics telemetry tiles, which had the identical bug. Added a lock around notification config saves to prevent two rapid saves (e.g. flipping the Master Switch and a destination toggle back to back) from racing each other server-side. Removed dead code and consolidated duplicated logic in the notification delivery and session-classification paths; fixed a related bug where a video-direct, audio-transcoding session with a different output container could be mislabeled 'Remux' in Discord/Telegram alerts instead of 'Transcode'.

Release v0.2.7.1 - Fixed a bug where the Master Switch (and the Discord/Telegram enable switches) could visually revert a few seconds after showing 'saved successfully' -- a slow settings request left over from page load could resolve after a save's own reload and silently overwrite it. Discord and Telegram enable switches now save immediately when flipped instead of requiring a separate Save click. The Test button for each destination stays disabled with an explanatory tooltip until that destination is actually configured, and a successful test now notes if the Master Switch is still off. Fixed a whitespace-only Telegram Chat ID being treated as configured. Added a redacted last-failure description to the diagnostics report for easier remote troubleshooting.

Release v0.2.7.0 - Unified the Now Playing dashboard widget with Connected Devices (shared glass/accent-ring styling, tinted by real playback method). Fixed the session grid leaving dead space with fewer active streams than columns. Poster art no longer stretches into a cropped sliver once Extended/Show Details makes a card taller. Compact mode now also shows bitrate, frame rate, and subtitle-active pills, a progress-completion ring on the poster, and real-world elapsed watch time next to ETA. The transcode reason is now a consistent highlighted callout in both Compact and Extended. The Info toggle can independently collapse one card while others stay open under Show Details, with a proper rotating chevron. Show Details is now grouped into titled Playback/Video/Audio/Stream/Subtitles sections. Fixed a bug where a malformed Discord webhook or Telegram bot token could block saving the notification enable switches entirely. Added delivery logging for successful Discord/Telegram sends to aid future diagnosis.

Release v0.2.6.0 - Rebrand from Playback Info Card to PlayInfo (new icon/banner, renamed everywhere in the live UI, not just the plugin name). Tautulli-style card redesign: poster art now bleeds flush to the card's edge and spans its full height instead of a small inset thumbnail, the blurred backdrop art is actually visible, and each card carries a colored status ring (green/blue/purple/red) matching its real playback method. New admin-only session controls: Send Message and Stop, calling Jellyfin's own native Session API, with a custom confirm dialog styled to match the card instead of a bare OS popup. Real Moonfin brand icon replacing the placeholder crescent. Relicensed from MIT to GPL-3.0, matching Tautulli.

Release v0.2.5.4 - Broadened client/device icon coverage: macOS and Linux sessions (previously falling through to the generic icon), non-Android smart TVs (Vizio, Hisense, and other VIDAA/SmartCast devices), and two more real third-party clients (Fladder, Jellyfin MPV Shim). Same resolver logic and icon set on both the dashboard widget and the standalone Playback Monitor page.

Release v0.2.5.3 - Merged the two sidebar entries (Playback Monitor / My Playback) into one: admins see every active session, non-admin users see only their own, decided by role instead of registering the same page twice. The dashboard widget's Info button no longer opens a slide-out side panel -- it now expands the same full field grid inline on that card, tracked by session ID so it survives polling, matching how the standalone page already worked and restoring the original in-card design.

Release v0.2.5.2 - Prominent summary strip above the grid shows total active streams plus a genuine Direct/Transcoding split (correctly counts a paused Transcode session as Transcoding, not silently dropped). High-signal pills (resolution, dynamic range, audio, subtitle) now carry a leading icon so they scan at a glance; codec/bit-depth/container pills stay icon-free. The progress bar moves from the card footer to directly under the title for better visual hierarchy. Deeper "liquid glass" treatment (backdrop blur, saturation boost, specular highlight, bright/dim edge split) applied consistently across the card, badges, pills, chips, and Info drawer on both the dashboard widget and the standalone My Playback page.

Release v0.2.5.1 - Standalone My Playback page brought to full parity with the dashboard widget (Info-panel persistence fix, ETA/Atmos/audio-language/subtitle-method/avatar additions, matching artwork/badge/transcode-reason logic), removal of a dead MVC controller superseded by the dashboard middleware, and added test coverage for the notification delivery service's safe-degradation behavior when the plugin has not yet initialized.
